svg.aria-label: CozyDuck Idle — a cozy idle farm game in Unity 6, coming soon on Steam
svg.title: CozyDuck Idle — a cozy idle farm game in Unity 6, coming soon on Steam

g.text: UNITY 6 (URP) · C# · WINDOWS & LINUX · COMING SOON ON STEAM
Solo project — design, programming and art direction
A cozy idle farm that lives in a small window on your screen. Duck workers harvest, haul and sell the crops; the player
decides what to grow, upgrade and unlock next — fields, a fishing pond, a prestige currency and a skill tree.
Every coin is carried by a duck: farmers
harvest, a truck hauls crates to the barn
and a shop duck sells them — all income
Six crop tiers, a prestige currency and a
A borderless window with size presets,
an FPS limit and a power-saving mode —
